rule.description: A storage-provider factory must not carry contract surface that no production runtime path can consume for that provider: a capability member of the shared provider contract violates the rule when the factory implements it under either (a) no production call site of that member exists at all, or (b) every production call site is gated behind a provider-key identity comparison that excludes the provider identities under which this factory runs. Provider-gated helper chains transmit their gates to the call sites they contain.

checks.description: Detect provider factories forced to implement shared-contract capability members for which no production call site exists anywhere.
checks.detected_relation: storage provider factory -> shared-contract capability member with zero production call sites
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The uniform provider contract obliges every backend to implement maintenance surface that no runtime path ever consumes; each such member is boilerplate the contract forces onto implementations that nothing in the program can use.

matches.evidence: local.ts:54 — listArtifacts implemented (fsPromises.readdir of the team directory); no call site of this member exists anywhere in src.
local.ts:62 — getModifiedTime implemented (fs stat atimeMs); no call site of this member exists anywhere in src.
s3.ts:226 — listArtifacts implemented (ListObjectsV2Command with the team as key prefix); no call site of this member exists anywhere in src.
s3.ts:243 — getModifiedTime implemented (HeadObjectCommand LastModified); no call site of this member exists anywhere in src.
google-cloud-storage.ts:66 — listArtifacts implemented (bucket getFiles with team prefix); no call site of this member exists anywhere in src.
google-cloud-storage.ts:80 — getModifiedTime implemented (object metadata updated timestamp); no call site of this member exists anywhere in src.
azure-blob-storage.ts:132 — listArtifacts implemented (listBlobsByHierarchy under a team prefix); no call site of this member exists anywhere in src.
azure-blob-storage.ts:145 — getModifiedTime implemented (blob properties lastModified); no call site of this member exists anywhere in src.

checks.description: Detect provider factories forced to implement shared-contract capability members whose only production call sites sit behind a different provider's identity gate.
checks.detected_relation: object-store factory -> shared-contract capability member consumed only behind another provider's identity gate
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The member is required by the shared contract and implemented by this backend, but the consumption paths that would justify it exclude exactly the provider identities this backend serves, so the backend permanently maintains capability it is never asked to exercise.

matches.evidence: s3.ts:199 — promote implemented (server-side CopyObjectCommand plus DeleteObjectCommand of the source key). Its only production call site is in createCachedArtifact, which routes every non-LOCAL provider away from the publish branch (gate STORAGE_PROVIDERS.LOCAL), so it is unreachable for the S3, s3 and MINIO identities this factory serves.

s3.ts:216 — remove implemented (DeleteObjectCommand). Its production call sites are the failed-upload cleanup path, reached only after the LOCAL-gated publish branch is taken, so it cannot execute for S3, s3 or MINIO.

google-cloud-storage.ts:57 — promote implemented (file.move server-side copy plus delete). Its only production call site is behind the STORAGE_PROVIDERS.LOCAL gate in createCachedArtifact, while this factory serves GOOGLE_CLOUD_STORAGE.

google-cloud-storage.ts:62 — remove implemented (file.delete). Its call sites live in the failed-upload cleanup path inherited from the LOCAL-gated publish branch, unreachable for GOOGLE_CLOUD_STORAGE.

azure-blob-storage.ts:111 — promote implemented (beginCopyFromURL plus pollUntilDone plus source delete). Its only production call site is behind the STORAGE_PROVIDERS.LOCAL gate in createCachedArtifact, while this factory serves AZURE_BLOB_STORAGE.
azure-blob-storage.ts:121 — remove implemented (blob delete). Its call sites sit in the failed-upload cleanup path inherited from the LOCAL-gated publish branch, unreachable for AZURE_BLOB_STORAGE.

excluded.location: exists / createReadStream / createWriteStream on all four provider factories
excluded.reason: Universal blob members consumed by ungated production paths (artifact reads and writes, signature-tag writes) for every provider, so they legitimately belong to the shared contract.

The publish and failed-upload cleanup flow consumes these members under the STORAGE_PROVIDERS.LOCAL identity, which the local filesystem factory actually serves, so the capability is consumable for that backend.

excluded.location: cleanStaleArtifacts local-only maintenance entry point (src/plugins/remote-cache/storage/index.ts) and its helper clean-local.ts
excluded.reason: Caller-facing maintenance capability that explicitly rejects non-local providers with notImplemented rather than forcing them to implement contract surface; it is the conservative handling pattern the shared contract bypasses.
Single-consumer declaration surface: fewer than two factories in distinct files implement them, so they cannot carry the cross-provider fat-contract relation.

excluded.location: Non-contract module helpers (isCacheMissError, getArtifactPath, etc.) and test/ sources
excluded.reason: Outside the provider-contract participation relation; the rule analyzes production src/ implementation surface only.
